question_text: A 7-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department because of a 3-day history of generalized fatigue, myalgia, and fever. He has sickle cell disease. His current medications include hydroxyurea and folic acid. He appears ill. His temperature is 39.2°C (102.6°F), pulse is 103/min, and respirations are 28/min. Examination shows pale conjunctivae. The lungs are clear to auscultation. The abdomen is soft and nontender. Neurologic examination shows no focal findings, His hemoglobin concentration is 10.3 g/dL and leukocyte count is 14,100/mm3. Intravenous fluid is administered and blood cultures are obtained. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in treatment?
